description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `an-axis-of-one-option.json` is refused by `axes/axis-of-one`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `dropThemes`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `themes`, a case that fired another check; with `rule` set to `axis-in-the-base`, a case that fired another rule.
